title: Chapter 2 · The artilugio in Gerard's hands
description: Once Bernat has sent it, the real board's notes (or the 1–4 keys standing in) have Gerard take the artilugio out of his pocket and hold it in both hands in the Meridiana flat: his thumbs press its four coloured buttons (both at once for a pair), its LEDs light with them and its little screen draws a bar for each note. Untouched, he puts it away. In the Queen's last fight it is awake, held out while she has Aitor. Run with --gpu --scale 2.

steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Jugador').getPosition(); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + .7, z: p.z }, 1.1); })()

steps.caption: At home, the artilugio in his pocket: nothing on screen says it is there
A key pressed: he takes it out of his pocket and plays Sol, Re, then the pair red + yellow (La♭)
steps.each: if (frame === 2) window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '1' })); if (frame === 40) window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '3' })); if (frame === 64) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '1' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '2' })); }

steps.caption: Held in both hands: the screen has drawn a bar for each note
Awake (the Queen's last fight): its four lights go round on their own
Six seconds untouched: he puts it back in his pocket
The Queen has Aitor: at the first note Gerard holds it out, awake, and she turns

steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt('gerard'); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + .7, z: p.z }, 1.2); })()

steps.caption: La♭ and Do, two pairs, both thumbs down for each: three of Aitor's six marks lit
steps.each: if (frame === 4) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '1' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '2' })); } if (frame === 34) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '2' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: '3' })); }

steps.caption: Close: the artilugio in his hands in the fight
